title: gomphia oblongifolia
intro: Gomphia oblongifolia, commonly known as the Yellow Ironwood or Yellow Iron Tree, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing fever, inflammation, and pain. The therapeutic actions of Gomphia oblongifolia include its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and analgesic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms associated with various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
